lines: The coffee you buy because you didn't make it at *home.*
The taxi because you left too *late.*
The subscription that renews because cancelling felt like *effort.*
#Nobody goes broke from one big purchase.
People go broke from a thousand *easy* ones.
And you're paying it every *day* without noticing.
It's about choosing when it's *worth* it.
Plan your week. Cook a little *more.*
Check what's renewing next month, and cancel what you don't *use.*
#A little effort today buys you a lot of *freedom* later.
Your future self doesn't care how easy today *was.*
end: Save this and check your subscriptions tonight.

post.title: Convenience Is Quietly Robbing You
post.caption: Nobody goes broke from one big purchase. It's a thousand easy ones. 💸
post.first_comment: What 'convenience' costs you the most each month? 👇
